title: Toward Out-of-Distribution Generalization in Neural AC Power Flow
abstract: arXiv:2611.23729v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Growing uncertainty in power system operations from renewables integration, extreme weather, and data center loads challenges the reliability of traditional power flow solvers at scale. Machine learning-based proxies are a potentially promising alternative, but the prohibitive cost of generating training data for large grids makes out-of-distribution generalization a key capability for deployment; currently, models trained on small grids lack that capability. In this work, we systematically evaluate how physics-informed losses, multi-grid training, and perturbation-based data augmentation improve the zero-shot transfer of three graph neural network-based power flow models from smaller systems to a larger, unseen 500-bus system. translated_title: 面向神经交流潮流的分布外泛化
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.23729v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：可再生能源并网、极端天气和数据中心负荷给电力系统运行带来的不确定性日益增加，这使传统潮流求解器在大规模应用下的可靠性面临挑战。基于机器学习的代理模型是一种潜在的替代方案，但由于为大型电网生成训练数据的成本过高，分布外泛化能力成为模型部署的关键；而目前在小规模电网上训练的模型恰恰缺乏这一能力。在本工作中，我们系统评估了物理信息损失、多电网训练和基于扰动的数据增强如何提升三种基于图神经网络的潮流模型从小型系统向更大的、未见过的500节点系统进行零样本迁移的能力。我们发现：(1) 相比纯监督目标，物理信息损失能改善迁移效果；(2) 在较小系统上进行多电网训练可以达到最佳单一电网的效果，但无法缩小与目标电网之间的差距。
tldr: 该论文系统评估了物理信息损失、多电网训练和扰动数据增强对图神经网络潮流模型从小电网向未见过的500节点大电网零样本迁移能力的提升，发现物理信息损失可改善迁移效果，而多电网训练虽与最佳单一电网持平，但仍无法完全缩小与目标电网之间的差距。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically evaluates how physics-informed losses, multi-grid training, and perturbation-based data augmentation improve the zero-shot transfer of GNN-based power flow models to an unseen 500-bus system, finding that physics-informed losses improve transfer while multi-grid training only matches the best single grid without fully closing the gap to the target.
